results.primaryHypothesis: A 10 bits/s biological reality stream pipe feeds an intelligently structured three-symbol cyclic input stream, clocked by rotating polygon spin, into an Infinite Octave recursive tree of holographic rhymes, implemented across folded compact DNA molecular structures — forming a coherent structure with beneficial outcomes vs unstructured/unclocked/flat/unfolded ablations.
results.honesty: TRGM architecture includes a 10 bits/s biological reality stream pipe that feeds a structured three-symbol cyclic stream (wave/node/fq), clocked by rotating polygon spin, into an Infinite Octave holographic-rhyme tree on folded compact DNA. Hard Goldilocks viability = geometry + wave + navigation; phase is a soft steering delta. Catalog is Soft Story association grammar — not gene→physics causation, not clinical genetics, not a measured neural bitrate. Batteries: E1–E5, H1–H3 (mixed), M1–M5, T1–T7, G1–G5, C1–C3 — executed, not fabricated.
